subject: Important Update Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in processing your recent purchase due to high demand. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to ensure your order is fulfilled as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your patience.
